datasets.name: Bot IP
datasets.summary: IPs bots use, from search and AI crawlers to monitors, scanners and webhook senders, each with its operator, its bots, what they do and whether the operator vouches for the address.

datasets.name: IP Company
datasets.summary: The organization that uses each IP range, with its domain and type, and the AS that announces the range.

datasets.name: Domain IP Ranges
datasets.summary: Every IP range an organization owns or uses, keyed by its domain, with the name and country registered for each range, one CIDR per row.

datasets.name: Domain IP Ranges Alias
datasets.summary: The domains whose home page redirects to an organization's in Domain IP Ranges, each with the domain to look its ranges up by.

datasets.name: IP ASN
datasets.summary: Announced IPv4 and IPv6 space mapped to its origin AS, with the holder and RPKI status.

datasets.name: IP Whois
datasets.summary: Every network record the registries publish, with its holder, status, contacts and parent network.

datasets.name: IP RWHOIS
datasets.summary: Reassignments published on network operators' RWHOIS servers, with their holders and contacts.

datasets.name: ASN
datasets.summary: Every allocated or announced AS number with its holder, domain, network type, announced space and RPKI standing.

datasets.name: ASN Extended
datasets.summary: ASN with each AS number's upstreams, peers and downstreams, its customer cone, its rank and whether it is Tier 1.

datasets.name: ASN Whois
datasets.summary: The registry record of every AS number, with its holder and contacts.

datasets.name: IP Abuse Contact
datasets.summary: Who takes abuse reports for every address range, with the email, phone and address.

datasets.name: IP RDNS
datasets.summary: The reverse DNS name of every IPv4 and IPv6 address that answers a PTR query.

datasets.name: IP Geolocation
datasets.summary: Every IP range mapped to continent, country, region and city, with the city's coordinates, timezone, postal code and GeoNames ID, an accuracy radius, the date the location last changed, and a US range's DMA code.

datasets.name: IP Country
datasets.summary: Every IP range mapped to its continent and country, each as a code and a name, with its timezone and the country's currency and flag.

datasets.name: IP Timezone
datasets.summary: Every IP range mapped to an IANA timezone, with its country.

datasets.name: IP Country Flag
datasets.summary: Every IP range mapped to its country's flag, as an emoji and its Unicode code points.

datasets.name: IP Country Currency
datasets.summary: Every IP range mapped to its country's currency: the code, the name and the symbol.

datasets.name: Carrier IP
datasets.summary: Mobile carrier address space, with the operator, its MCC and MNC, and the country.

datasets.name: Satellite IP
datasets.summary: Satellite internet address space, with the operator, its orbit and market, the subscribers' country and a confidence.

datasets.name: CDN IP
datasets.summary: IPs operated by content delivery networks.

datasets.name: BGP Route
datasets.summary: Every announced BGP prefix with its origin AS, collector visibility and RPKI status; multi-origin (MOAS) prefixes kept, one row per origin.

datasets.name: SSH IP
datasets.summary: Every host that completed an SSH handshake on TCP port 22, with its server banner and host-key fingerprint.

datasets.name: SMTP IP
datasets.summary: Every host that returned an SMTP greeting on TCP port 587, with the greeting banner.

datasets.name: DNS Resolver IP
datasets.summary: Every host answering DNS on UDP port 53, flagged for recursion and whether it is a working open resolver.

datasets.name: Web IP
datasets.summary: Every host that answered a TLS handshake or HTTP request on TCP port 443 or 80, with the TLS certificate, JA3S, HTTP Server header, status, redirect, cookie names and page title.

datasets.name: BitTorrent IP
datasets.summary: Every address where a BitTorrent client was seen in the last 90 days, flagged verified or not, with how many clients shared it at once and the codes they identify themselves by.

datasets.name: Domain List
datasets.summary: Every registered domain in the generic top-level domains, .com, .net and .org among them, and in .fr, .se, .sk and a few other country codes, with the domains in use under the rest, .de and .uk among them, one name per row.

datasets.name: Domain DNS A
datasets.summary: Each domain's IPv4 addresses from its A records, with CNAMEs followed, one address per row.

datasets.name: Domain DNS AAAA
datasets.summary: Each domain's IPv6 addresses from its AAAA records, with CNAMEs followed, one address per row.

datasets.name: Domain DNS MX
datasets.summary: Each domain's mail exchangers from its MX records, with their priorities, one record per row.

datasets.name: Domain DNS NS
datasets.summary: The nameservers each domain is delegated to, one per row.

datasets.name: Domain DNS CNAME
datasets.summary: Every CNAME record seen on a domain or host name, with the name it points to, one per row.

datasets.name: IP Hosted Domains
datasets.summary: Every IP address registered domains resolve to, with how many there are and up to 1,000 of them, the most popular first, one address per row.

datasets.name: Range Hosted Domains
datasets.summary: Every announced IP range registered domains resolve to, with its AS, how many domains there are and up to 1,000 of them, the most popular first, one range per row.

datasets.name: ASN Hosted Domains
datasets.summary: Every AS whose addresses registered domains resolve to, with how many domains there are and up to 1,000 of them, the most popular first, one AS per row.

datasets.name: Disposable Domain
datasets.summary: Every domain whose email addresses are disposable, rated high, medium or low, with the first and last day we saw it in use and the providers behind it, one domain per row.
